title: Law to ban license plate readers in taxis and for-hire cars
summary: This bill would prohibit owners and drivers of taxis and other Taxi and Limousine Commission-licensed vehicles from using automatic license plate readers in or on their vehicles. It would also bar base stations and dispatch services from requiring or encouraging such use. Violations carry a $500 civil penalty for owners and drivers and $2,000 for base stations and dispatch services, with repeat violators risking license suspension, revocation or non-renewal.
